rules.title: Preserve architectural boundaries
rules.summary: Keep dependencies directed toward the domain and avoid boundary leaks.

rules.title: Search before adding behavior
rules.summary: Reuse or generalize an existing component before creating a parallel implementation.

rules.title: Keep modules cohesive
rules.summary: Prefer small modules with one reason to change and explicit inputs and outputs.

rules.title: Do not ship placeholders
rules.summary: Do not leave TODO implementations, fake success, or silent fallbacks in completed work.

rules.title: Keep secrets out of artifacts
rules.summary: Never print, persist, or commit resolved credentials or sensitive environment values.

rules.title: Verify observable behavior
rules.summary: Use the narrowest behavioral test first, then broader checks proportional to risk.

rules.title: Exercise boundaries and failures
rules.summary: Cover empty, missing, boundary, concurrency, timeout, and network-failure behavior where relevant.

rules.title: Do not hide failures
rules.summary: Fix the cause instead of weakening assertions, suppressing diagnostics, or swallowing errors.

rules.title: Keep data changes deploy-safe
rules.summary: Plan compatibility, locking, integrity, rollback, and mixed-version operation for migrations.

rules.title: Make failure behavior explicit
rules.summary: Define timeouts, cancellation, retries, idempotency, and observable errors at effectful boundaries.
